title: Echobound
tagline: A third-person action RPG where fire, water and lightning follow real rules and so do the monsters.
stateNote: A vertical slice built in Godot 4.3 for the browser, phones included.
problem: In most games, elements are scripted. In Hollowmere, fire spreads with the wind through dry grass, water douses, conducts and freezes, and lightning races through everything wet.
audience: Action RPG players who like systems that interact, and Godot developers.
contribution: It is my project. The README says every mesh, texture, sound and music layer is generated by the project's own code.
worksToday: A 240 m handcrafted biome with a plateau arena, a cavern and a lake, per the README.
limitations: I checked that the title screen loads, not the gameplay.
It is a slice, not a full game.
